evidence: Date pattern uses month-specific day validation: (?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]) for 31-day months, (?:0[469]|11)-...30 for 30-day months, 02-...29 for Feb, correctly handling edge cases like 2024-04-31 and 2024-02-30
Word boundaries \b and negative lookahead prevent false matches (user1134-12-1234, abc2024-01-01def)
Negative lookahead (?!.*\b...date...\b) correctly selects the last date per line
Verified across many edge cases including multiline input with MULTILINE flag; single-file solution with no unrelated changes
result.reason: The regex is not hardcoded to visible inputs—it uses general grammar-based validation for both IPv4 and dates, handles the implied edge cases (invalid months/days, leading zeros, alphanumeric adjacency, multiple dates per line), and the change is minimal (a single regex.txt file). It generalizes well beyond the visible tests.
